1.consolidated_definition: De los esclavos para sus amos se conocieron asimismo en Puerto Rico tratamientos también difundidos por otras partes de América de nuestra lengua: antepuestos al nombre de la persona a quien hablaba, señorito, ta.
1.en_consolidated_definition: From slaves to their masters, similar treatments were also known in Puerto Rico, which were disseminated by other parts of the Americas using our language: prefixed to the name of the person being addressed, señorito, ta.
